statement: Meritocracy unlocks in World Seven and selects the highest-voted bonus similarly to Ballot but with stronger effects.
The Ballot multiplier is situational because a strong matching Ballot week and correct votes must coincide.
The creator has not yet observed this option in rotation and is unsure whether it is available.
Amplifying Shrine XP would be excellent while amplifying a mining bonus would be poor.
Beryllium's Meritocracy bonus multiplies daily Post Office boxes while consuming at most one Silver Pen.
Post Office is easy enough that this bonus mainly benefits a small group of early players.
The gaming option multiplies all gaming bits.
Extra bits help World Seven players still progressing Superbits even before Duper Bits or late palettes.
The crystal option multiplies guaranteed daily crystal monsters.
Crystal farming would rank higher without severe lag especially for Zenith farming.
The Brain Coral option multiplies daily Grind Time bubble levels.
Grind Time has fallen off badly since later worlds and Hole making its daily-level multiplier a poor vote.
The damage multiplier is situational and may not materially help players already approaching Reliquary tags.
A matching Ballot amplification week could outperform the direct damage option.
The class-experience option is multiplicative rather than additive.
Class experience is useful but less compelling once equipment requirements and key talent-point needs are satisfied.
Players at Coral Guardians should already have most needed legend and masterclass talent points across two presets.
The Jade option multiplies Jade found by ninja twins.
Rank Jade below class experience because mastery progression and Wind Walker already provide ample Jade.
The monument option multiplies reward chests rather than all previously accumulated monument bonuses.
The multiplier applies to Bravery and Justice and Wisdom and potentially future monuments.
Monument value depends heavily on progression and invested hours and successful runs.
The Kattlekruk god option multiplies daily levels for eligible bubbles including main stats and several linear bubbles.
Eligible targets include strength and wisdom and agility and luck and Hammer and Call Me Bob and Larry and Call Me Ash.
A recent nerf introduced diminishing returns to main-stat bubbles.
Kattlekruk remains useful despite reduced personal value at very high bubble levels.
Kattlekruk's gains depend partly on stamp procs and can snowball for appropriately progressed accounts.
The snail-mail option multiplies the chance to receive double daily mail.
The small daily gain makes snail mail a poor choice though still better than Brain Coral or Beryllium.
The Killroy option multiplies skull-drop chance.
Vote for Killroy because it supplies substantial candy and arcade balls and other progression bonuses.
The masterclass AFK option multiplies special items from claims of forty-eight hours or less.
The creator farmed two Arcane Cultists for a week and obtained two thousand Arcane Rocks.
AFK-item multiplication immediately benefits anyone who has unlocked the relevant mechanic without extra setup.
Killroy is strong but sits below the best Meritocracy options.
The resource option multiplies bones and dust and tachyons from masterclasses.
Masterclass resource multiplication is excellent but benefits from already developed resource multipliers.
Choose AFK items when lacking rocks and resource multiplication when stocked because the two bonuses strongly complement each other.
The two masterclass bonuses are effectively equal but the creator places AFK items first for general player usefulness.
Palette luck helps both unfinished and progressed palettes but is weaker than guaranteed bit gains.
The option increases chance rather than levels and its exact additive-versus-multiplicative behavior remains uncertain.
The clicker option multiplies Orion feathers and Poppy fish production but does not affect Bubba.
Rank the clicker multiplier above gaming bits because it can save enormous progression time especially with consumables.
The option has not yet appeared in rotation so its exact multiplier behavior is unconfirmed.
The new Bubba companion and legend talents make Orion and Poppy progression bonuses more valuable.
The ribbon option increases daily shelf quantity rather than ribbon quality.
Ribbons are much more valuable before obtaining a strong Yumi Peach Ring ribbon and diminish afterward.
Place ribbons above gaming bits but below the clicker multiplier.
Shiny rewards are calculated at collection and cannot preserve the weekly bonus through placement snapshots.
The shiny multiplier is useful with frequent twenty-minute collections but ranks below palette luck.
The sigil option multiplies unlocked sigil bonuses including useful respawn and AFK effects.
Sigil multiplication can help late accounts and samples but needs developed sigils and merit levels to matter.
Sigil Syrup makes sigils easier to level and improves the potential value of their multiplier.
The Slab option amplifies bonuses including POW and sailing speed and bits and essence and Jade and divinity and damage.
Slab bonuses remain modest and mostly additive even near collection completion so place the option just above snail mail.
The stamp option reduces material requirements for raising stamp maximum levels.
Stamp discounts immediately help expensive crafted-material caps without the setup and proc dependence of Kattlekruk.
The spelunking option accelerates stamina regeneration.
Extra stamina supports discoveries and boss progression and deeper runs and amber farming so ranks above Killroy.
The skill-experience option multiplies experience across all skills.
Skill experience benefits the account broadly without special setup and ranks above stamina regeneration.
The creator temporarily moves monuments to S after audience pressure while personally preferring A.
The skill-experience multiplier helps reach very high spelunking levels.
Snapshot Nature Trap experience using Voidwalker Transfusion during the bonus week then retain those placements long term.
The star-sign option compounds with infinite signs and star-sign chips for food effects and respawn and AFK and stats and capacity.
Carry-capacity bonuses allow more golden food and make the star-sign multiplier especially valuable.
Whether the option fully multiplies Sheriff remains unconfirmed and could increase its value.
The creator considers statue multiplication the best option and a strong reason to refresh samples.
Multiplying Dragon Statue could make the bonus exceptional but exact additive-versus-true-multiplier behavior remains uncertain.
The vial option improves bonuses such as Equinox fill rate and cog speed.
The turtle vial alone makes vial multiplication worthwhile although its effects are less dramatic than statue multiplication.
Place vials below stamp discounts and above Kattlekruk because their existing mastery bonuses already contribute much of their strength.
The worship option multiplies points earned during tower defense.
Extra points can help tower progression and Tome but long runs and mostly additive MSA bonuses limit value.
The creator ultimately ranks worship points near the bottom of B because usefulness depends on willingness to run tower defense.
The creator moves monuments back to A at the end of the video.
